title: Mixed Event — One Small Trip Before a Big Journey

meta.Event: One Small Trip Before a Big Journey
meta.Outline: The Miya Girls first years are headed to Yokohama! Haruka realizes this field trip might be her last memory with her general education class before returning to the credit-based course. Saki asks to be in her group for the trip.

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright class, I will now go over the schedule for our upcoming field trip.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: We will be meeting up at Kannai Station at 9 a.m. and heading over to the History Archive Museum from there. You will then have free time starting at 12 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: In a short moment, I would like you all to form groups of five for the day.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow! Yokohama!
It's gonna be so hard to decide where to go during free time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If we're going to Yokohama, then the Chinatown over there is an option. But I'm sure there are plenty of other places to go too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Definitely! Oh, I wanna try those steamed buns or sesame balls!
Minato Mirai seems super pretty too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I can't wait to take loads of photos with everyone!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (A field trip...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Since switching to the general education course, I've been able to experience so many events. The Sports Festival, the School Festival, and even the Seaside School...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm also switching back to the credit-based course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because it's the best way for us to spread hope to as many people as we can.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It won't be long until I'm back to being in the credit-based course.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (So this might be the last time I get to participate in an event like this...)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright then, Hoshino. As class representative, will you do the honors?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. Understood.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Without further ado, please form groups of five.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: For this field trip, you will be spending the allocated free time in your groups. Each group will need to submit their itinerary for the day.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please submit your itinerary once you have a plan, preferably during homeroom time.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Roger dodger, Class Rep!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You can find the itinerary template sheets and some guidebooks at the front. Feel free to pick those up once you have formed your groups.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Please keep to a total of five members per group. You may now start!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh, who should I form a group with...?)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Haruka, Ichi! Wanna form a group together?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
W-Wait, was I too late?!
Do you already have a group?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: No, not yet. If you don't mind, I'd like to be in a group with you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Really?! Thank goodness!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's all have a fun time, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I'm looking forward to it.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if we're forming groups of five, we'll need two more people, right? Who else should we invite?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, I've got that covered! I have candidates!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: If you're okay with it, can I invite two girls from the soft tennis club? That would bring us to five in total!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. I'm fine with that.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. Thanks, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
Alright, I'll go ask them now. Be right back!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Sorry for the wait!
They didn't have a group yet, so we're all set to be a group of five!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Please meet my friends from the soft tennis club, Sono and Ino!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you for the introduction, but we already know each other, remember?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looking forward to spending the day with you two.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah! Looking forward to it, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I can't believe I get to be in the same group as Kiritani. It's like I'm dreaming. Let's all have lots of fun!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well then, shall we start planning? I'll grab a template sheet and a guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Okie dokie! Thanks, Ichi!
I guess we can use some of these desks over here.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's push these desks together!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Wh-Whoa! Be careful!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Hehe.
Looks like it's going to be a lively trip.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright! Let's put our heads together and plan a fun itinerary!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Yeah!
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Class 1-C

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's see... Free time starts at 12 p.m., and we'll need to come up with enough things to do until 5 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: With five whole hours, the world is our oyster!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we will need to meet up with the rest of the class before going home, so we probably shouldn't go overboard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, then let's make sure we leave some leeway in our plans so we'll be in time to meet up at 5 p.m.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is there anywhere in particular you'd like to go, Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This place has all-you-can-eat meat buns... And if we go down this street, then we can also have yum cha...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki, are you listening?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wha?! I-I'm totally listening!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Leave it to me! I'll whip up an ultra fun plan to fill up all the time that we have!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
I knew it. You weren't listening at all.
We were just talking about how it'd be better not to do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I can understand where you're coming from, though. It's so easy to get carried away when looking at the guidebook.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe. I can't help but want to do everything when reading through these sorts of things...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
And check this out!
Aren't the peach buns from this place so cute?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, they're so little and cute.
They're shaped like peaches, but they have a custard filling.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
And it's all-you-can-eat?!
I could probably eat so many that I'd lose count!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, right?
We should totally have an eating competition!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, sounds fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But if we fill up on those, it won't leave much stomach space to try other stuff, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, true...
It'd be a shame to not try a bunch of stuff while we're there.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, let's look for other things outside of Chinatown. How about exploring around Minato Mirai?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's a great idea! There's a bunch of really classy spots around there! Where should we start?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, look. We can go on a tour of a ship over here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See? They have photos too. It looks so grand...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're right! You can not only see the inside of the ship, but also enjoy a really nice view from the deck!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Oooh. I wouldn't mind going.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks nice! Shall we put it down in our itinerary?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Alright, putting it down now!
We should find somewhere nearby for lunch, but what would be good...?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hmm, good question...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Lunch nearby...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I know. How about this curry place?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Curry?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I went there once for a shoot. The place was stylish and the food was really delicious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: For a shoot?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, sounds good.
There's a description of the place in the guidebook too.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
You're right. It says...
“Enjoy the authentic flavors and enticing aromas of curry from Yokohama, its birthplace in Japan.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! Sounds amazing! I'm sure it won't be a miss, especially since Haruka recommended it. Can we have lunch here?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, if everyone is alright with it, then I'll write it down on our itinerary.
Where should we go afterwards?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: How about the Red Brick Center? We can get some souvenirs and stuff there!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Good idea. I'm sure they have a lot of things for sale. In that case...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This is fun. Just looking through the guidebook with everyone is making me so excited...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(But it is Yokohama, though...
There's going to be a lot of people, so I should probably put on some sort of disguise.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I hope we all have a good time together.)
bgm_area00002
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Field trip itinerary?
That's right, I guess it's already that time of the year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So where are you all going this year?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yokohama. We'll be going to the History Archive Museum for some studying, and then we'll have free time with our groups.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My group and I were talking about walking around the harbor, going on a tour of a ship and having some curry for lunch.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That sounds like so much fun! I'm sure the sea breeze would feel wonderful.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Where was the field trip when you were first-years?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We went to PXL.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to go since I had work.
But more importantly, Yokohama is such a classy place to visit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
PXL and Yokohama both sound super fun♪
Minori, since you're also a first-year, does that mean you're going too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Me and Haruka are in different classes though, so we won't be able to go around together...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But my group and I have decided to go around Chinatown!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There's supposed to be a lot of good food over there, right? What are you going to try?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Let's see... So first things first, that famous meat bun place! And then the famous peach bun place, and then that pot sticker place...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
You're planning to eat all of that?!
I think I'd be too full to go on...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Don't worry! All of us want to try a bunch of stuff, so we'll be splitting everything within the group.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh, smart!
It'll be much more fun getting to try a variety!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I wonder what sort of food would be there...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! In that case, let's flick through the guidebook together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I actually brought it with me! Ta-da!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Look at you, all prepared.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe, I wanted to show it to Miku and everyone!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's so sweet♪ Show me, show me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, let's look at it together!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Check this out, Miku!
This steamed bun is shaped like a panda!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
It is!
It's called a “panda bun”. That's so cute!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
And this castella looks so soft and yummy!
I wonder what it tastes like.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, then I'll get some for you as a souvenir!
We can all share!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Really? Thanks, Minori!
Looks like Yokohama is just full of delicious things to eat♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm also curious about that curry place Haruka mentioned.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I didn't know you were such a glutton, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Huh? D-Did I sound like one?
But they all sound so good...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe, I understand how you feel.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then I'll also bring back some yummy souvenirs so you don't feel like you missed out, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Y-You too, Haruka?!
I would really appreciate it, though...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ah, Airi, Shizuku! We'll definitely get souvenirs for you too, so please look forward to them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you. Then I shall be patiently waiting.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Minori, Haruka, you two are always working really hard, so please try to relax on your field trip as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I agree! You're always putting in everything you have for your shows and work.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a special occasion, so please enjoy your field trip as any high school students would!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: As high school students...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, you're right.
Thank you, Miku.
The day of the field trip
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Seeing all those rows of books at the History Archive Museum was pretty amazing. It was also helpful that there were photos included with the documents they had on display.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the building itself was very beautiful. I think that kind of architecture is referred to as “retro-modern”.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
It did have its own presence.
Saki was freaking out and yelling “this place is so pretty!”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
What?! I wasn't freaking out!
I was just regular excited—

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! Oh my gosh, look! The water!
The seagulls are playing together!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, and history repeats itself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I understand how freeing this feels. The smell of the sea is also very refreshing.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Hey, Kiritani. I've been wondering for a while, but are those glasses...supposed to be a disguise?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, yes. I don't usually wear a pair, but since I'm here with all of you today, I wouldn't want to cause a ruckus because of a fan spotting me.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Y-You...really are a star!

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: But, I do see a lot of pictures taken of celebrities I like uploaded onto social media. I guess celebrities have it tough, huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well... It can be tough, but fans show their support in different ways, and that support always makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Classmate
rows.Line: Wow... You really do think about your fans, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: And I think that's enough chatter for the time being.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, you will now have free time. Please assemble into your groups before heading off.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I will be doing a roll call before dismissing you home, so please be at the station by 5 p.m. sharp. If there are any problems, contact me immediately.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Hehe, I like your attitude, Tenma.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright everyone, do not forget that you are all representatives of Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy. But at the same time, go have fun and enjoy yourselves.

rows.Speaker: Students
rows.Line: Understood!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okie dokie, everybody! Off we go!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think we have the ship tour first on our itinerary.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup! I know the view from the deck is supposed to be really nice, but I can't wait to see the captain's cabin and stuff either!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I feel the same way. We should make the most of this opportunity, so let's take our time looking around.
Ship Deck

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow, I didn't realize how large a ship's deck is.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Just like the guidebook said, the view from here is really beautiful. You get to see the city and the water, and pretty far out on a sunny day like this.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, there's a tower over there! I bet we could get an even better look from the top of that! You think we'd be able to see the Ferris wheel across the way?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Apparently this ship was used to host parties and stuff before. I wonder if this is what celebrities did to have fun.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I'm sure they did! I bet they were thinking how nice the sea breeze felt when they were up here...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh, the wind's getting a little stronger... Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Ah! Inoue!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Inoue, are you alright?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Y-Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Please be careful. It would be awful if you hurt yourself.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: O-Of course. I'm ever so grateful for you saving me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? Why are you talking like that?

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: She's probably just smitten by Kiritani's idol aura, no?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
I-It's not like I can help it!
I mean, there's no way anyone could resist that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Um... It's a little embarrassing when you put it like that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, we've had a look around inside the ship, so shall we head over for lunch? I'm starting to feel a little hungry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me too, me too!
I feel like it's only a matter of seconds before my stomach growls.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, then we'd better hurry.
Curry Restaurant

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wow! So this is the curry place you talked about, Haruka?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
The terrace seating really adds to the atmosphere.
It looks even better in real life than in the photos.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, it's beautiful, isn't it?
Looks like they aren't that busy right now, so we should be able to get a table.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's hurry up and go in! I'm starving!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Wow, even the interior is really pretty!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They have a lot of things on the menu too. This lunch special that comes with Salisbury steak looks really good.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You came here for work before, right, Haruka? What did you order back then?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I had the chicken curry lunch special. At the time, I ordered it with rice, but maybe I'll go with naan this time.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, you'll be ordering the chicken curry again? I guess it's just that good, huh.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh no, everything looks so yummy that I can't choose!
I think I'm leaning towards this green curry...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I heard that's really spicy, so maybe be careful.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Another performer who was at the shoot with me had that, and it was so spicy that they fainted from the pain. That curry is apparently quite infamous.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Wow, dodged a bullet there... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, OH MY GOSH!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wh-What's wrong, Saki?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Look! Look over there!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: That's...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's Haruka's autograph!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Wow, it is!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Amazing... Haruka really is famous...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Could you all please stop staring at it?
Besides, that's from back when I was in ASRUN.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, we should probably order soon so this doesn't eat into our schedule.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You got it! Alright, I think I'll order...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yummm!!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: The guidebook did say it was authentic, but the spiciness makes it so delicious! I think I'm starting to feel kinda hot...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Haha. I'm glad that the chicken curry isn't so spicy.
I went with rice, but the naan looks really good too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, it's very nice and freshly made too.
It's so soft and chewy, I feel like I could eat a whole lot of it.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
We get to see fun and interesting things, eat delicious foods...I'm so happy. If only we could have field trips every day...

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I don't know if that's a good idea.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
But I totally get how you feel!
Speaking of which, don't we get to go on a school trip next year? I can't wait!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Where do you think we'll get to go for our school trip? Hokkaido? Or maybe Okinawa?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Some of the second-years in my club were saying that they're going to Kyoto. Right?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh yeah, they did say that. But I'd rather go to Okinawa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, I think it might change when it's our turn. A second-year I know told me that they went to PXL for their field trip.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, true!
Then I guess we'll just have to wait and see where we get to go for our school trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we get to be in the same group again!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: In the same group...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: But we might not be in the same class next year, and then wouldn't we only see each other when everyone gathers?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I guess that could happen...
But if we're lucky, we might all end up in the same class again!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I think there's a limit to luck, though.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, I think so too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani, are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, yes. It's nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The curry I got was just spicier than I expected.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess since everyone's done, shall we head out?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's!
In front of the Red Brick Center

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wow, it's way bigger than I thought!
So this is the Red Brick Center!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It looks pretty retro, or like a building you'd see in another country.
The shops inside are supposed to be just as classy as the exterior, right?

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
I think so.
I'm pretty sure the guidebook said that there's a Building 1 and a Building 2, but... Is the bigger one Building 1?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Actually, it looks like the smaller one is Building 1. Shall we head over there first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I just remembered. Would it be alright if I went to buy some souvenirs?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Since we're already here, I was hoping to get some while we still have time.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Yeah, sounds good. I was thinking the same thing!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okie dokie! First stop is the souvenir shops, then! Let's go♪
Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Alright, now that I've bought souvenirs for Miku and the others, I should be good.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (How is everyone... Hm?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, is everything okay? You look troubled.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani. Actually, I'm struggling to decide which souvenir to get.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I have a friend who tutors me on singing, but I'm not sure what to get for her...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. Does she also play in a band?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, no. She's actually a PXL cast member.
She's an absolutely amazing singer.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: She's taught me so much, so I'd really like to get her something nice...
The night of Leo/need's solo show
Ichika's Room

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
After that bath, I feel like I can finally relax.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
We actually had our first solo show...
And yet, it doesn't feel like it's fully over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Someone's calling me...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Kusanagi?
I wonder why she's calling me this late.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hello. Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Oh, hi... Sorry for calling this late.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's alright. I just got out of the bath and was about to have some barley tea.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Hehe, I see. Make sure to keep warm.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Um, Hoshino... Congratulations on your first solo show. You sang so well.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <All of the things you and your bandmates wanted to convey really came through. So...I was really moved by your performance.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm glad. It makes me so happy hearing that from you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Also... I think you're part of the reason today went well.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You've been helping me with my singing all this time, right? Thanks to that, I've been able to improve... And that's what kept me working hard for this solo show.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, thank you very much.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. It's nothing.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <But hearing you sing...made me want to try harder too.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <The way you sang with such confidence up there today was so cool...>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <It made me think, “Wow, my friend is amazing.” After that, I felt like I should be more brave.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <It made me want to work harder, so that I can stand on stage the same way you did.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kusanagi...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: <Sorry for dumping all of that out of nowhere. That was weird.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, not at all. Let's both keep working hard.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see...
So you're hoping to find a gift for her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. I was thinking of getting her something that can be a sign of my support...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Something that can give her support...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, how about something matching?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Something matching?
Like a keychain?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. You know, I think a reminder that she's not alone would help her have courage whenever she's feeling anxious.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A fan once told me how concert merch had that effect on them.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Concert merch?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. They said the matching merch they bought with their friend cheers them up because it reminds them of that shared memory.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I see... I think I can understand where they're coming from. Saki has said something similar before.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: In that case, I'll get her something we can have a pair of.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I wonder what would be good...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (This little blue bird...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: (I remember Kusanagi mentioning that the main character of this musical she recommended treasured something like this...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That looks good. They would be cute as a pair.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I think so too! I'll go with these little blue bird keychains.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you, Kiritani. I'm glad I was able to pick something nice.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope your friend likes it.
Hey! It's Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: The girl wearing glasses?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: You're right! It's Haruka Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Uh oh, what should we do? At this rate, people are going to start gathering...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani, this way—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wait, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Haruka's coming this way! I'm gonna ask for an autograph!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: What? You don't even have anything she can write on! Let's just shake her hand!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. I see that you were able to see through my disguise. Well done.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: I could tell it was you straight away since you're so pretty!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. It makes me happy hearing that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I have a favor to ask all of you. Would you mind listening?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Really? What is it, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The thing is... I'm actually in the middle of a game of hide and seek.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't want anyone to know where I'm hiding, so... Could you all please keep my location a secret for me?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: I didn't know that! Okay, my lips are sealed!

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: But as a trade, can I shake your hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, of course.

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Me too, me too! Can I have an autograph?

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Teacher
rows.Line: Alright everyone, that's enough—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's okay.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't have a pen or paper, so I won't be able to sign autographs...but if you wait quietly and patiently, I can take turns shaking your hands?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sorry about this, Hoshino. I know Tenma and the others will worry if we don't get going soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I know. Could you go ahead first? I'll meet up with you after this.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
(Kiritani's amazing...
She's an idol even in a place like this.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay. I'll wait for you with the others.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, Hoshino.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, so who's first?
Several minutes later
Red Brick Center - Building 1, 1st Floor

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright everyone, see you next time. Remember to keep this a secret, okay?

rows.Speaker: Elementary Schooler on a Field Trip
rows.Line:
Okay! We promise!
Take care, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Phew, looks like they were satisfied.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But that took much longer than I expected. I don't want to keep Hoshino and the others waiting, so I'd better hurry.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (We were all supposed to go around as a group, but we ended up separating. I feel bad.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: First things first, I need to go meet up with them as soon as I can.
2nd Floor
Apparel Store

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Where could they be?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (They just replied to my message saying they were in this shop, but...)

Oh! There she is!
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma! Everyone! I'm so sorry for making you wait...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? What are you all doing?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ta-da! We picked out some stuff that will create the perfect disguise for you, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: We were just talking about what a famous person would wear and what would suit you, and ended up trying on a bunch of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A disguise that makes you look famous would defeat the purpose, though.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Oh, but don't worry! We didn't pick anything like that!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This way you'll be able to walk around without being interrupted!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You're right. Sorry for the trouble.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ah! No, no, that's not what I meant!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I just want to enjoy today's trip as much as possible with you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, we got to be in the same group!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Tenma...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not just Saki. We all feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I know that you really care about your fans, and perhaps it's selfish of us to feel this way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But we really want to make the most of this field trip and have fun with you.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: We were thinking about what we can do to help, and the only thing we came up with was picking out some stuff for a disguise...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's a special occasion, so please enjoy your field trip as any high school students would!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (That's right... I came here to have fun as any regular student would.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I made plans with everyone for that purpose. And yet... I wasn't following through.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, everyone. That makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I do think a lot about my fans and want to give back what I can for their ongoing support.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But even so, I also really want to have fun with all of you. And that is the truth.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I think I'll take you up on your offer and let myself fully enjoy this trip!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's all have a great time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going back to the disguise, what items have you picked out?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Well, we had a hard time picking out a hat, but what do you think of this flat cap?
I think this would totally suit you♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's nice. It has a simple design and I can probably wear this on any regular day too.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah, it looks really good on you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: What about these sunglasses? I thought they would look really cool on you.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'll pass on those. They're a little too flashy and might actually attract more attention.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: See? I told you those were too flashy!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But I thought they'd look really good on her...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Glad that we were able to find something good!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Yeah! It really suits you, Kiritani!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I didn't realize that you could look so different just by wearing a hat. I don't think anyone will notice now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? That's a relief. Now I should be fine to relax and just enjoy walking around.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what should we do next? Did you want to stay here for a little longer?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We managed to get the perfect disguise for you and I got my souvenirs, so I'm pretty satisfied!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too. We finished up earlier than we planned, but shall we head out anyway?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Hey, did you see? Apparently Haruka Kiritani was here today.

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Huh? Haruka Kiritani? You mean THE Haruka Kiritani?

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Yup! She's trending on social media right now. Quite a few people are saying they saw her, so I think it's legit!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Oh no... They're talking about me.)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Did people find out from hearing those kids before?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I think so...
But it should be fine because of the hat you all picked out for me.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh! They're coming this way!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Apparently, she's really pretty and slim in person! I wish I could see her!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line:
What if she's nearby?!
If we bump into her, let's try asking for a photo!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Looks like they left...

rows.Speaker: Ichika & Saki
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I was so anxious that they were going to recognize you!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me too... My heart was racing.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: I know, right?! My palms are so sweaty!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hehehe.
Operation Disguise was... A. Big. Success♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Yes, it was.
Outside the Red Brick Center

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was interesting to see so many different kinds of shops.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah! I couldn't help but get carried away looking around the shop with all sorts of stuff from Scandinavia. Having some of that in my room would totally brighten my mood any day!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
I've always liked those kinds of things too!
Also, can we talk about how nice those fragrance shops were?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Actually, yes. Not only were the scents really nice, but the way they displayed all of the perfumes was so pretty too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
You can say that again!
All of the shops were pretty busy, huh? I thought it'd be quieter since it's a weekday, but I guess I was wrong!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Speaking of which, is it just me or has it gotten even busier?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, so you think so too? I was just thinking that a bit earlier...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I guess it is also after lunchtime, but I wonder... Could they be looking for Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That is a possibility. The people that passed by us before did say that they saw posts about her on social media.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Here, look. This video has the title, “Haruka Kiritani being sweet to elementary school kids!”
It's trending and there's four thousand likes on it already.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What?! F-Four thousand?! That's amazing! Good work, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Now's not the time to be celebrating!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: “Red Brick Center” is written in the description, so I'm sure that's why people came looking.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It seems like leaving early was the right decision...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehe, now that we're heading off somewhere else, I'm sure we won't have to worry about anyone finding us!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well then, let's head over to—

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wah...!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Whoa! What was that?!
That strong wind just came out of nowhere... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ah! My hat!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Huh? That girl over there, is that...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Oh no...
Even if it was just for a second, our eyes met...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wh-What should we do?! At this rate...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Kiritani's going to be found out and there's nowhere to hide!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, what if we hide her with our bodies?!
But that would look super unnatural!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoa! Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Kiritani! This way!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Let's get on that! I think we'll make it just in time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That? Do you mean the water taxi?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Hoshino?!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Sh-She just suddenly grabbed Kiritani's hand and took off...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, Ichi.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But, that's a relief. I'm sure Haruka will be fine.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Alright, now it's my turn...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ah! Look over there!
There's Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: What? Where?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Looks like she went to that park over there!

rows.Speaker: Passerby
rows.Line: Really? Shall we go have a look?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh! Another big success!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Nice work, Saki! You're a genius!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hehehe, you flatter me as you should!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (To be honest... I feel kind of bad for doing something like this to Haruka's fans.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (But this is our one field trip together. If this is what needs to be done for Haruka to enjoy herself, then...)

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
So what should we do now?
Should we follow them?

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: I think they got on the water taxi, right?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yup!
Let's go ahead and wait for them at their arrival terminal!
Water Taxi

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huff... Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sorry for suddenly dragging you like that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's okay, I'm glad you did.
Looks like there aren't many people here, so we should be able to relax.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There were quite a lot of people looking over there, and if they'd found me, I don't know if we'd have been able to carry on with our field trip.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More importantly, I'm sorry for all of this. Because of me, we both got separated from the others.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: No, it's okay. Also, Saki sent a message just before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here, in the group chat. “We'll be waiting at the arrival terminal!”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. I completely missed that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It might not seem that way, but Saki has a good head on her shoulders, so I think we have nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I'm sure they'll be having fun in their own way.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, right on cue.
They just sent a message and a photo.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <We're on the way to the arrival terminal now! We'll be enjoying ourselves, so make sure you two have fun too♪>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: They're all feeding each other.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: They sure are. Looks like they're having fun.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said that we got separated, but I think it's fine since it'll only be for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like we'll never see each other again. Once we meet up, let's make the most of the rest of the day and enjoy ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hm? Ah!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki and the others are eating crepes! I'm jealous, they look so good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. You can tell from the look on their faces too. It's like they're saying, “Yum!”

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's a little unfair.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Then, shall we give them a taste of their own medicine?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Their own medicine?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. It's not food, but... We have a beautiful view of the water. Why don't we send a photo?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's do that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what pose should we do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh, a pose? Do you mean like peace signs?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well, yes, but I was thinking that maybe we can do something a little cuter.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: A cuter pose?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. For example, we can make hearts with our fingers and place them next to our cheeks.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, I see... Then, how about a pose of us eating sweets? Saki and the others got to eat crepes, so we should try to rival that.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Sweets? That's a good idea.
But would that come across without having any actual sweets?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: About that... The thing is, I actually have some donuts.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Here. I got them at the souvenir shop and thought that they might be a nice snack for all of us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Wow, they look so yummy. But, are you okay with that?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Well, I'd say it's perfect payback for the crepes.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe, right.
Okay, lean in.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino, maybe try nibbling it.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: L-Like this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Ooh, that's cute. Okay, here we go.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: H-How does it look?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It looks great. Alright, I'll send this over.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, okay. Thank you. It's a little embarrassing, but I wonder how they're going to react.

rows.Speaker: Saki's Message
rows.Line: <You're eating our snacks?! I thought you said they were for all of us?!?!>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, she sent an angry stamp.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Operation Payback was a success, then.
Water Taxi

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess it won't be long until we arrive.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. Saki and the others said that they're waiting for us at the terminal.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right. They sent a message.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, Tenma uses some really interesting stamps.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, do you mean the sumo stamps?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Are these crying sumo stamps a series?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Apparently. She's really liking them lately, so she's been using them a lot.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But seeing them every day has made them grow on me, so I ended up buying them too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Really? I didn't realize you have the same ones.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, you two really are close.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're childhood friends and in the same band after all.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right... I guess being in the same group would naturally bring you closer. And even more so if you're childhood friends too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Definitely. But Saki and I weren't always together growing up.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh... That's right...
Tenma was away for a while due to illness, wasn't she?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, she was staying at a faraway hospital until a little while ago.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So... There was a point when we were apart for a while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I was a little anxious back then since we had always been together up until that point. But I believed that Saki would recover in no time and it'd all be fine.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Even though I held onto that belief, her recovery ended up taking longer than I thought.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure that must've been lonely...
Were you able to keep contact with her during that period?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I went to visit her and we sent messages to each other. However, the time we actually spent together in person was quite short.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There were even times when I felt Saki had become kind of distant.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: When she got out of the hospital, I was really worried about what would happen if we couldn't talk the same way we used to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hoshino...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But after I got to see her again, all of those worries went away. Because in the end, it was like nothing had changed.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: And that's how we've come to now.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki wanted all of us to stick together, and made that happen. Thanks to that, we were able to form a band together and are now closer than ever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... I didn't realize all of that happened.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Tenma and Hoshino are amazing... I can only imagine how much courage it would take to meet a friend you haven't seen in so long.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (If things didn't work out, then that friendship would just end right there.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Would I be able to do that? I...)

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Kiritani, look. I can see the terminal getting closer. I think we'll be arriving soon.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh? Oh, you're right.
I didn't even notice.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Me neither. I had so much fun talking with you that time just flew by.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm glad I got to learn more about you and your band members. Thank you for telling me.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Going above and beyond so that you can all be together again... Tenma sure is amazing. But that sounds a lot like her.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes. She really is a strong person. I know that she had it way harder than me, and yet she was just as cheerful as ever.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She still is now, and has lots of friends too.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Saki's always been really social. She even started calling you by your first name straight away, didn't she?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, now that you mention it, she did.
Heeeyyy!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heeey! Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, speak of the devil...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, she's waving. She sure is peppy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Welcome back, you two!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We're back. Sorry for making you all worry.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Haha, we were a little surprised, but everything's okay!
I was thinking that was very much like you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You said that we got separated, but I think it's fine since it'll only be for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: It's not like we'll never see each other again. Once we meet up, let's make the most of the rest of the day and enjoy ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (It's not like we'll never see each other again, huh... That's true.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (There's nothing wrong with just...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Being apart for a little while.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I'm so glad that we were able to meet back up!
Was everything okay after that?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes, everything was fine.
No one called out to me or anything.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone... I'm truly sorry for all of the trouble today.

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Huh? Don't worry about it! If anything, it was pretty fun!

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
Yeah!
It was exciting and kind of like we were in a drama!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It so was! Really, it was no trouble at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Besides, while you two were sitting around on the water taxi, we ate some sweets, went shopping and had some fun♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: See, I told you. We had nothing to worry about.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I guess you're right.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What's this? You two are like super close now!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Hehe, not at all.
More importantly, look at the time!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: We only have an hour left until we have to meet with the rest of the class in front of the station.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: Huh?! You're right! I didn't realize so much time has passed!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There isn't really much we can do within an hour, is there?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Then why don't we just walk around here?
I mean look, the water is so pretty and quite a backdrop for us teenagers, no?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But, that sounds good.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. Since we're here, let's walk around until we have to go.
Yokohama

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
The wind feels so nice!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It really does. Oh, that's right...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry for losing the hat. After all of you picked it out for me...

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line:
Don't worry about it!
At least you won't have to worry about it flying away anymore.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hahaha, true! If it looks like you might get recognized again, we'll hide you with our bodies!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line:
Yeah! Leave it to us!
We should be able to hide you easily since you're slim, Kiritani.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I don't think it'll get to that level... But if it does, then I'll be counting on all of you.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Despite some things happening midway, today was actually really fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Sure was! But to make up for the things we couldn't do today, let's go somewhere together again!

rows.Speaker: Sonoda
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean by “somewhere”?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I mean, remember what we talked about at the curry place? We were wondering whether we get to go to Okinawa or Hokkaido for the school trip, right?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (The school trip...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But I won't be...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We should all go together on our own first!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh?
Go together first?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's true. It's not like we can't travel there outside of a school trip. Going together, just us, sounds like fun.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Doesn't it? I mean, I can't wait until the school trip! If trips are this fun, then I want to go on lots of them♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's go in headfirst and jump on a ship or a plane like Ichi just before!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What do you think, Haruka?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Well... I think I might get busier with work, which could make planning more difficult...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even so, is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Yes, of course.
Saki and I will probably get busier with band stuff too.

rows.Speaker: Inoue
rows.Line: We'll be busy with club, so we're in the same boat!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, so let's make plans when we all have time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Everyone...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. In that case, we can go whenever it suits us.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'd like to come too. No matter where we go, I'm sure it'll be a fun trip if it's with all of you.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
...?
Is something wrong, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Actually, there was something I've been meaning to say for a while.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What was with that photo you two sent?! I can't believe you would send something like that!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Oh, um, that was payback...
Besides, you and the others went to eat crepes without us.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But you ate our snacks! So pot, kettle!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Wait, I'm getting sidetracked!
It's so unfair that you got to take a selfie with Haruka! I want to be closer to Haruka too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh... Tenma, I thought that we were already quite close friends.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: That! That right there, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I've been wondering about this forever! When will you call me by my first name?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Th-That's what you were talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, got it. I also want to be closer friends with all of you, so...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's make more memories together, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: *Gasp*

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: S-So bright!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Saki. You're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But... I'd also like it if you could call me by my first name.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course. I'd like to make more memories with you too, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Wow...!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I-I think I understand how Minori feels now...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: See! I wasn't exaggerating at all!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
But it makes me happy that we got to bridge that gap!
Can't wait to hang out with you more, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, I feel the same.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Thinking about this being the last school event I could participate in made me a little sad at the beginning, but...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I was having so much fun that I completely forgot.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (This day is going to be one of my most precious memories.)
bgm_area00002
Nighttime
Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for buying souvenirs for all of us, Haruka! You really didn't have to...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It was my pleasure. I'm sorry for visiting so late. I really wanted to see all of you, and the next thing I knew, I was here.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Hehe, I see. So, how was it? Did you have fun?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. I went on the water taxi and got to see a very beautiful view of the harbor from the ship's deck.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: There was a huge variety of souvenirs as well. But I ended up going with these since the packaging was so pretty.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I hope you like them.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: This... Oh, it's chocolate shaped like a brick. The packaging is also super pretty!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Wow! Looks so yummy! I want some.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There's no need to rush. Haruka has bought enough for all of us♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Thank you, Haruka. I'll be sure to savor every bite.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Are you not having any, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm okay. I've been looking forward to the souvenirs too, but right now I'm just enjoying the look you have on your face♪

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh? My face?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. You've been smiling since the moment you got here, you know?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's how I know you had such a fun time on your field trip, and now even I've started feeling happy too!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I see.
I really did have a lot of fun. When I was in Yokohama, and even now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Even now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. Even after we all went home, we've kept messaging each other in the group chat.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Oh!
What are you all talking about?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, I took a really cute photo with a friend, so all of us started talking about taking more photos together sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Would you like to see the photo, Miku?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Can I? Yes, please!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay. Here it is.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Wow, that's a really nice shot! The water is beautiful and your poses are so cute♪

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You look like you're having so much fun! I can see it in the photo.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe, yes. I did have a lot of fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Also, my friends suggested that we should go travel together again sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Even though I told them that I'll probably get busier with work, they said it's fine because they'll be busy too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that...made me really happy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see... Your friends are so sweet!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, they really are.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm...so glad that I switched to the general education course. Even if it was just for a little while.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Had I not done that, I don't think I would've ever been able to experience what I did or become close friends with everyone.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hey, I'd like to hear more about your friends. Could you tell me about what happened today in more detail?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: It might be a long story, though. Is that okay?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yup! Of course!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, so today...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm going to treasure the memories I made today.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Even after I return to the credit-based course, I want to stay close friends with Ichika, Saki and everyone, so...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I want to savor this feeling for a bit longer.)
